name: teamdynamix-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the TeamDynamix Web API — search tickets, KB articles, people, and assets via Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to your TeamDynamix instance via the TDX Web API. Provides tools for searching and managing tickets, knowledge base articles, people, and assets. Uses a decision-tree navigation pattern to lazy-load domain tool sets on demand, keeping the initial tool footprint small.

author.name: Aaron Sachs / Chattanooga State Community College

web_services_key.title: Web Services Key
web_services_key.description: TeamDynamix API Web Services Key (GUID format)

ticketing_app_id.title: Ticketing App ID
ticketing_app_id.description: TDX Ticketing application ID (optional — auto-discovered if not set)

assets_app_id.title: Assets App ID
assets_app_id.description: TDX Assets/CI application ID (optional — auto-discovered if not set)

kb_app_id.title: Knowledge Base App ID
kb_app_id.description: TDX Knowledge Base application ID (optional — auto-discovered if not set)

tools.name: tdx_navigate
tools.description: Load a TeamDynamix domain tool set (tickets, knowledge_base, people, assets)

tools.name: tdx_status
tools.description: Returns the current status of the TeamDynamix MCP server
